text:
Felix Support: quick escalation - SageMetrics (SM-720) onboarding blocked. Invites sent but users can't accept - bounce error from invite handler. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/72411
Nina CS: thanks. renewal timeline + who is CSM? @Diego
Felix Support: renewal in ~41 days. CSM is Diego. Customer running 3-team eval across EU and US.
Diego CS Manager: I'm on it. paste the raw error & what support tried so far
Felix Support: log snippet:
```
InviteError: recipient_domain_not_allowed - attempt to accept invite from user@contractor.sagemetrics.io blocked by allowlist
Account allowlist: *.sagemetrics.com, sagemetrics.io
```
Felix Support: I retried resend-invite and tried alternate token flow; same rejection. IdP not involved here (they're using email invites).
Nina CS: ok 1 plan: 1) warm transfer to CS in 30m, 2) send customer-safe exec note now, 3) prepare a short technical fallback (Solutions) + a temporary policy toggle, 4) schedule enablement for tomorrow 09:00 CET. Diego, can you own handoff?
Diego CS Manager: will own. Diego -> create shared invite (include customer IT and their security contact), set success metric = all pilot seats accepted by EOD tomorrow CET, add account note: "onboarding-risk: invite allowlist". Also loop in AE for renewal watch.
Rae Solutions: drafting fallback steps (concise):
- confirm account allowlist entries in account settings UI
- temp toggle: `redwood org update --org SM-720 --allow_any_domain true --note "temp fallback"`
- resend invites: `redwood users resend-invite --org SM-720 --emails-file invites.csv`
- validate with `curl -sSf https://app.sagemetrics.com/_status`
I'll post draft in #eng-platform for quick review; fallback requires Ops approval and will be reversible.
Owen AE: I'll prep renewal outreach copy in case activation slips past 48h and pull in exec sponsor. Please ping me if we switch to manual invite flow.
Nina CS: comms: two templates. Exec-friendly (short): "We're investigating an onboarding blocker related to email allowlist rules. Temporary workaround being prepared; scheduling enablement for tomorrow 09:00 CET." Ops-facing (detailed) with steps for their IT. Felix please send exec-friendly now.
Felix Support: sent at 4210000202. Customer replied: "Thanks. We'll include our security contact and can do 09:00 CET tomorrow." :white_check_mark:
Diego CS Manager: owners recap: Diego -> warm transfer & invite; Rae -> publish fallback and get Ops signoff; Nina -> add renewal watch (7-day cadence) and capture feedback; Owen -> prep AE outreach. I'll update account health to "at-risk - onboarding" and flag renewal.
Nina CS: capturing product feedback: onboarding quickstart lacks guidance for contractor/third-party email patterns and allowlist best practices. Filing to product board.
OpsBot: Task created: SM-720-warm-transfer assigned to Diego, due 4210000840.
Rae Solutions: note - fallback toggle requires Ops approval and audit log. I'll prepare reversible commands and a rollback plan.
Diego CS Manager: good. I'll also add a policy note in the account: "Do not enable allow_any_domain > production without SOC approval; temp allowed for onboarding debug only."
Nina CS: I'll post a follow-up summary here after the enablement call and confirm whether the renewal cadence needs AE escalation. Thanks team. :pray:
